heading: Damaged personal protective equipment: award to members separating from the Armed Forces and veterans

tree.heading: In General.—
tree.text: The Secretary of a military department, acting through a disposition service distribution center of the Defense Logistics Agency, may award to a covered individual the demilitarized PPE of that covered individual. The award of PPE under this section shall be without cost to the covered individual.

children.text: a member of the armed forces—
under the jurisdiction of the Secretary concerned; and
who is separating from the armed forces; or
a veteran who was under the jurisdiction of the Secretary concerned while a member of the armed forces.
The term “PPE” means personal protective equipment that was damaged in combat or otherwise—
during the deployment of a covered individual; and
